text: Android: SettingsViewModelTest and InboxSeenInvitesTest time out under the parallel gate

Investigation so far. (1) The error is coroutines-test 1.11.0 TestBuilders.kt:353, runTest's real-time timeout (60s): either the body did not finish or children were left; the test scope launches nothing of its own (the view model's collectors live in viewModelScope), so it is the body stuck in one of its waits: setInviteNotificationsEnabled(false).join(), uiState.first { !inviteNotificationsEnabled }, or the two direct DataStore .first() reads — every one waits on a DataStore emission after an edit, and InboxSeenInvitesTest's wait (seenInvites.first after the view model's edit) is the same shape. (2) Healthy, the failing test takes 0.09s and the 826-test suite 163s of test time (XML reports), so a 60s stall is not CPU contention; it is a wait that never resumes. (3) Read DataStore 1.2.1 DataStoreImpl: data emits the start state, then collects an in-memory versioned StateFlow with dropWhile(version <= start); updateData runs through a write actor that bumps that state and runs the transform on the CALLER's context (here Dispatchers.Main = the StandardTestDispatcher). No lost-emission path found by reading. (4) Reproduction with evidence: a worktree (t369 branch) adds kotlinx-coroutines-debug and installs DebugProbes from both MainDispatcherRule copies, allows JVM self-attach, and sets runTest's default timeout to 20s; verified that a hung runTest then prints a coroutine dump into the test report naming the suspension point. Eight stress runs of both Android test tasks are running there, under the load of three full gate runs in the main checkout.
